description: Docs drift: revoked Origin CA certificates keep returning from GET/list with `revoked_at` set on the live wire (distilled models it; the delete response already has it in the docs), but the docs omit the field from get/create/list shapes — so callers polling for revocation (alchemy's provider and its test) spin forever on an undefined revokedAt.
